observations.behavior: Documentation update: removed a sentence claiming the judge uses an internal LLM gateway and added a sentence claiming it calls OpenAI API directly with OPENAI_API_KEY.
observations.code_quote: - Dataset-derived content still leaves the machine on three paths. Two reach a model provider: the Gemini scans, which are the same provider call production already makes through `run_scan`, and the `summary_alignment` judge, which sends the recorded and fresh summaries to `gpt-5.4`. The third is the harness's `$ai_evaluation` capture, which stays inside PostHog.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that the evaluation harness uses an external OpenAI API call rather than an internal gateway, potentially changing the supply chain and security posture of AI evaluation. No score assigned.
